source_obligations.statement: Honor an express retained-copy exception; absent such an exception, treat an express direction that no copies or derivatives be retained as contradicting the queried permission.

source_provenance.quote: Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed.

Receiving Party’s legal department or outside legal counsel may maintain a single copy of Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information for purposes of regulatory compliance and compliance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement.

The Receiving Party shall upon request immediately return to the Disclosing Party or destroy, as directed by the Disclosing Party, the Confidential Information and all copies thereof in any form whatsoever under the power or control of the Receiving Party or its Representatives
